tagline: Documents, contracts and paperwork of your household – organised in folders
description:
DMS is a self-hosted document management system for households and families. Contracts, insurance, tax, car, house, medical bills: every topic gets a folder with the fields you need, documents are searchable thanks to built-in text recognition, and reminders make sure no deadline is missed.

After installing, open the app: a setup assistant asks for the name of your household and creates the first administrator. The database is already connected. The user interface is in German.

- Folders with your own fields, registers and views
- Full-text search, also in scanned PDFs (OCR)
- Tasks, reminders, notes and a daily summary by e-mail
- Several users with roles and permissions
- Encrypted backups with an emergency sheet, restore in the browser

tips.before_install: Open the app right after installing and finish the setup assistant – until then everyone in your home network could do it. Afterwards, create a backup schedule under Werkbank → Sicherung and copy the backups to another place from time to time.
